title: Composition of coherent upper shriek for proper morphisms
statement: Let $Z$ be a Noetherian scheme and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type between Noetherian schemes. For each such morphism $h$, write $h^!$ for the right adjoint of $Rh_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] on derived categories of quasi-coherent sheaves [def-pc-derived-category]. There is a natural isomorphism $(g\circ f)^!K\cong f^!(g^!K)$ for every quasi-coherent complex $K$ on $Z$, compatible with the adjunction counits of $f$, $g$, and $g\circ f$.

source.place: Tag 0ATX, Lemma 48.16.3 (composition of upper shriek); proper case

proof.text: The comparison c and restricted-functor comparisons eRf, eRg and eRfg are hypotheses of the Lean statement. Compose their whiskerings and functor associators to obtain (Rf followed by Rg) followed by the inclusion isomorphic to Rfg followed by the inclusion. Cancel the fully faithful inclusion using Functor.fullyFaithfulCancelRight to obtain q : Rf ⋙ Rg ≅ Rfg.

Compose the supplied adjunctions af and ag using Adjunction.comp, then transport the left adjoint along q using Adjunction.ofNatIsoLeft. Apply Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq to afg and this transported adjunction to obtain ufg ≅ ug ⋙ uf.

Map Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit through the inclusion. Expand the transported counit and Adjunction.comp_counit_app; Functor.map_preimage identifies the inverse of q after inclusion with the inverse of the whiskered comparison. Finally the naturality equation for eRg.inv at af.counit.app (ug.obj K) gives precisely the displayed composite counit.
